name: CITY COUNCIL MEETING
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
September 24, 2024 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Deacon Paul Machuca, Beatitudes of Our Lord Church
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: La Mirada Friends of the Library
4.
ROLL CALL:
Councilmember De Ruse
Councilmember Otero
Mayor Pro Tem Eng
Mayor Lewis
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PROCLAMATION FOR NATIONAL HISPANIC HERITAGE MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim September 15, 2024 through October 15, 2024 as National Hispanic Heritage Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Allison Ortiz.
5.1 Proclamation
5.2
INTRODUCTION OF NEW CITY EMPLOYEES - It is recommended the City Council welcome Nicholas Massey and Ramon Valenzuela and present them with a $40 gift certificate to Panera Bread restaurant, a voucher for two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts, and two passes to Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center.
5.2 Introduction of New Employees
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council.)
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
REAPPOINTMENT TO THE COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION – It is recommended the City Council reappoint Desiree Johnson to the Community Services Commission for a term ending in June 2028.
7.1 Reappointment to the CSC
7.2
DESIGNATION OF A VOTING DELEGATE FOR THE LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES ANNUAL CONFERENCE AND EXPO - It is recommended the City Council designate Councilmember Anthony A. Otero to serve as the City of La Mirada's voting delegate at the League of California Cities Annual Conference and Expo.
7.2 Appointment as a Voting Delegate - League of Cal Cities
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of September 10, 2024 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of September 10, 2024.
8.1 Minutes of 9-10-24 SS
8.1 Minutes of 9-10-24 CC
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated September 24, 2024 in the total amount of $1,139,987.14.
8.2 Warrant Register - City
8.3
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING AUGUST 2024 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending August 2024.
8.3 Investment Report
8.4
APPROVAL OF A WAREHOUSE NON-EXCLUSIVE LICENSE FOR PHANTOM PROJECTS - It is recommended the City Council approve the non-exclusive license for Fiscal Year 2024-25 for Phantom Projects and authorize the City Manager to execute the license on behalf of the City.
8.4 Agreement for Theatre Warehouse
8.5
ENERGY CONSERVATION AND INFRASTRUCTURE RENEWAL PROGRAM - APPROVAL OF CHANGE ORDER NO. 1 - It is recommended the City Council approve and authorize the City Manager to execute Contract Change Order No. 1 to the agreement between the City of La Mirada and Climatec, LLC in the amount of $29,261.
8.5 Climatec CO No. 1
9.
PUBLIC HEARING
9.1
SECOND READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 734 ADOPTING TITLE 10 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE, BY REFERENCE, AND AMENDING TITLE 8 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as required by law and accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 734 adopting Title 10 of the Los Angeles County Code, by reference, and amending Title 8 of the La Mirada Municipal Code, by title only, and waive further reading.
9.1 Ord. No. 734 - 2nd Rdg
10.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
10.1
RESOLUTION NO. 24-17 APPROVING THE APPLICATION FOR TRANSIT AND TRANSPORTATION FUNDS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2024-25 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 24-17 approving the application for transit and transportation funds for Fiscal Year 2024-25.
10.1 Reso. No. 24-17
11.
CITY COUNCIL REPORTS AND ANNOUNCEMENTS
12.
CITY ATTORNEY ANNOUNCEMENTS
13.
CITY MANAGER ANNOUNCEMENTS
14.
ADJOURNMENT
I hereby certify, under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.

Leticia Revilla, City Clerk
